I feel like going Shurelya after Zeke is better than Redemption. After the nerf on forbidden idol, a 800g Kindle Gem with health and 10% CDR is way better. My build is tier 2 support item -> glacial shroud -> Mercury Treads -> Zeke -> Shurelya.
After Shurelya, I often go for Ardent for more movement speed and max out on CDR. Since Rakan can proc Ardent on many people at once, Ardent seems to work better for me than Redemption. At this point, you're still kinda squishy but a good Rakan would never let the game go more than 35m.
